claims: The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place on Monday, April 13, at 7 p.m. ET (6 p.m. CT).
The 2026 WNBA Draft takes place from The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City.
The 2026 WNBA Draft will be broadcast on ESPN.
The 2026 WNBA Draft can be streamed on the ESPN App.
FuboTV is a live coverage option for the 2026 WNBA Draft.
"WNBA Draft Orange Carpet Show" airs at 5:30 p.m. ET on ESPN2.
"WNBA Countdown" airs at 6:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Sling TV offers a "Day Pass" to watch events live, including ESPN channels.
The ESPN App requires a cable or streaming provider login to watch.
The Dallas Wings hold the No. 1 overall pick.
